headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 30, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Didier Fuentes earning the win. JJ Bleday led the Braves' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the San Diego Padres defeated the Washington Nationals 7-5, with Curtis Mead finishing with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs in 4 at-bats.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Blake Snell has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to loose bodies in his left elbow, while Teoscar Hernández is on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Brant Hurter's lumbar spine inflammation, Casey Mize's right adductor inflammation, Tyler Mahle's left hamstring strain, Eury Pérez's right gracilis strain, Nick Mears' right shoulder impingement, and Jordan Leasure's right flexor strain.

The Detroit Tigers made a roster move ahead of the deadline, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. Other notable trades include the Colorado Rockies trading LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, the Philadelphia Phillies trading RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations, and the Cincinnati Reds trading RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Reds 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured an 8-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Didier Fuentes earning the win. JJ Bleday led the Braves' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Nationals 7-5**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 7-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the team at the plate. Mead finished with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged the Minnesota Twins 6-5, securing a crucial win. Trevor Larnach led the Twins with 2 hits, including a home run, while Bryan Reynolds' 6th homer of the season proved to be the game-winner.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mason Fluharty earning the win and Braydon Fisher securing the save.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Blake Snell Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers left-handed pitcher Blake Snell has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to loose bodies in his left elbow. This move indicates a longer recovery period for the injured pitcher.

top_news.title: **Tigers Make Roster Move Ahead of Deadline**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The trade was announced on May 27, 2026.
